toolOfTheDay.name: Stable Diffusion
toolOfTheDay.summary: Stability AI's landmark open-weights latent diffusion model that democratized high-resolution text-to-image synthesis by operating in compressed latent space for consumer GPU training and inference, incorporating an architecture of latent diffusion model with CLIP text encoder and U-Net denoising network. The model demonstrates competitive performance across verified evaluations, including FID score competitive with DALL-E 2. With its 890M params design, it supports diverse local and enterprise deployment profiles under the CreativeML Open RAIL-M license.
toolOfTheDay.architecture: Latent diffusion model with CLIP text encoder and U-Net denoising network.
toolOfTheDay.usage:
from diffusers import StableDiffusionPipeline
pipe = StableDiffusionPipeline.from_pretrained("stabilityai/stable-diffusion-2")
image = pipe("a photo of an astronaut on mars").images[0]
toolOfTheDay.limitations: Can produce biased outputs, requires GPU for reasonable speed.

citations.text: Rombach et al. (2022) - Latent Diffusion Paper
